execution_modes.name: chat
execution_modes.description: Realtor sent a message via /api/ai/task (Modal chat_turn). Identify the real job, run tools, answer in chat. Drafts surface a draft id rather than sending.

execution_modes.name: autonomous
execution_modes.description: Triggered by application_submitted / tour_completed / new_lead / deal_stage_changed / inbound_message / goal_completed, or a periodic sweep. Take actions and stop. Always end with log_activity_run.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.summary: Create a new contact (lead / buyer / seller / rental) in the workspace.

tools.name: find_contacts
tools.summary: Find contacts by id, name substring, lead type, overdue follow-up, or quiet-days sweep filter.

tools.name: get_contact_activity
tools.summary: Most recent activity entries for a contact.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.summary: Update a contact. Pass only fields to change.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.summary: Create a new deal in a pipeline stage. Links contact ids when known.

tools.name: find_deals
tools.summary: Find deals; supports stalled-days and closing-within-days filters used by sweeps.

tools.name: update_deal
tools.summary: Update a deal. Probability and follow-up dates only from chat — never status/value/title.

tools.name: advance_deal_stage
tools.summary: Move a deal between pipeline stages by stage name (case-insensitive) or id.

tools.name: request_deal_review
tools.summary: Flag a deal up to the broker for human review.

tools.name: book_tour
tools.summary: Book a tour for a contact at a specific time. Requires contact email on file.

tools.name: route_lead
tools.summary: Preview by default (commit=False); set commit=True to actually move the contact to the destination realtor's space.

tools.name: add_property
tools.summary: Add a property to the realtor's inventory.

tools.name: send_property_packet
tools.summary: Draft a packet share message with the secure packet URL pre-filled. Pass packet_id or property_id.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.summary: Semantic recall across the workspace. query= for topic search, entity_id= for a specific contact.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.summary: Store a memory for future runs. Auto-embedded. Use for things a realtor will care about in six months.

tools.name: manage_goal
tools.summary: Manage persistent agent goals (create / list / update / complete).

tools.name: manage_routines
tools.summary: Manage the realtor's routines — standing instructions Chippi runs on a schedule.

tools.name: draft_message
tools.summary: Create a pending AgentDraft for the realtor to approve. Auto-dedupes within 48h on contact+channel. NEVER sends.

tools.name: outcome
tools.summary: Record an outcome or summarise outcomes.

tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.summary: Analyse the full contact and deal portfolio for the space.

tools.name: generate_priority_list
tools.summary: Generate a ranked list of contacts the realtor should focus on today.

tools.name: process_inbound_message
tools.summary: Process a reply received from a contact.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.summary: Read the contents of a chat attachment by id (PDF / DOCX / XLSX / text).

tools.name: ask_realtor
tools.summary: Ask the realtor a one-sentence question when intent is genuinely ambiguous.

tools.name: log_activity_run
tools.summary: Persist an entry to AgentActivityLog. Required at the end of every autonomous run.

tools.name: recall_docs
tools.summary: Search the app knowledge base for help and how-to documentation.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.summary: Announce a structured execution plan BEFORE carrying out a complex task. Required for 2+ contacts/deals or 3+ tool calls.

tools.name: get_intake_form
tools.summary: Fetch the current intake form config for this space. Always call this first before any edit.

tools.name: add_intake_question
tools.summary: Add a new question to a section (creates the section if it doesn't exist).

tools.name: remove_intake_question
tools.summary: Remove a question by its label. System fields (Name / Email / Phone) cannot be removed.

tools.name: update_intake_question
tools.summary: Rename, re-option, or change required status on an existing question.

tools.name: save_intake_form
tools.summary: Replace the entire intake form config in one call. Use only for wholesale rewrites.

tools.name: generate_studio_image
tools.summary: Generate a branded image or short video for the realtor with Studio. Saves to Files + Studio.

tools.name: edit_studio_image
tools.summary: Edit an image the realtor already has (upscale, cut background, restyle by instruction). Pass file_id. Chain after generate_studio_image.
